title: Jubilant French Ground Pork Casseroles
description: A hearty French dish featuring ground pork and kombu cold extract, perfect for a post-workout meal, this casserole is high in protein and cooked to perfection in a Dutch oven.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the ground pork over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Stir in the kombu cold extract, tomato paste, and chicken broth, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked quinoa, shredded cheese, and the pork and mushroom mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a Dutch oven and cover with a lid.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
